seo.title: Majuro homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Majuro.

page.heading: MAJURO - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: 911. Violence, shelter and emergency support for women and girls: WUTMI 625-4296 or 625-5290.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Majuro does not publish a general walk-in homeless shelter. Women United Together Marshall Islands provides emergency casework, shelter and material or financial support for women and girls. Other residents can contact the Marshall Islands Red Cross or government social services, but assistance depends on assessment and current programmes.
page.footer: Main sources: Women United Together Marshall Islands, Marshall Islands Ministry of Health and Human Services, Marshall Islands Red Cross Society and Micronesian Legal Services Corporation.

entries.title: Women United Together Marshall Islands
entries.description: Emergency casework, shelter, material or financial aid and referrals to health, police and legal services for women and girls aged 14 and older.
entries.how_to_access: Call 625-4296 or 625-5290. Use 911 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Leroj Atama Memorial Hospital
entries.description: Main hospital in Majuro for outpatient and emergency care.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the hospital or call 911 in a medical emergency.

entries.title: Weto in Mour safe support
entries.description: WUTMI programme providing confidential shelter and case support for women and children affected by violence. Admission depends on safety assessment and space.
entries.how_to_access: Contact WUTMI. Do not travel to a confidential shelter without referral.

entries.title: Marshall Islands Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian, health and disaster assistance. Support is based on assessed need and current programmes.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain the situation. Use 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: Leroj Atama Memorial Hospital
entries.description: Public hospital providing outpatient and emergency medical care in Majuro.
entries.how_to_access: Attend for urgent care. Ask about payment and identification requirements for non-emergency treatment.

entries.title: Micronesian Legal Services Corporation - Majuro
entries.description: Civil legal assistance for eligible low-income residents, including family safety, economic stability, health access, land and document matters.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the Majuro office and ask about income eligibility and intake.

entries.title: Women United Together Marshall Islands
entries.description: Confidential casework, advocacy, emergency shelter and material support for women and girls affected by violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call WUTMI or 911 if there is immediate danger.
